name: Phoenix Laroche
bio:
Phoenix Laroche is a British actor who has gained fame for portraying Ethan in the Apple TV+ drama series “Trying” which also stars Rafe Spall and Esther Smith.  Laroche has had a love of performing from a young age, creating and starring in a series of online videos with his brother and dad over the pandemic. His experience also includes the comedy series “Trying” and various commercials and voice over work.

The young actor starred in the lead role in the adaptation of The Velveteen Rabbit, which was released by Apple Tv + in 2023.
